title: Yuri Is My Job!
romaji: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu!
nativeTitle: 私の百合はお仕事です！
synopsis: Hime Shiraki cares deeply about maintaining her pristine, flawless persona. After accidentally injuring cafe manager Mai, she is forced to work at Cafe Liebe, a themed salon where waitresses act like refined maiden academy students.
famousQuote: In this salon, our love is just an act... or is it?
aliases: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu

title: Sailor Moon S (Haruka & Michiru)
nativeTitle: 美少女戦士セーラームーンS
synopsis: The legendary romance between Sailor Uranus (Haruka Tenoh) and Sailor Neptune (Michiru Kaioh) that defined yuri representation in 90s anime. Bound by fate, music, and eternal devotion, they protect the cosmos together.
famousQuote: A world without Haruka is not a world worth saving.

title: Mai-HiME (Shizuru & Natsuki)
synopsis: At Fuka Academy, female warriors called HiME fight deadly Orphans with materialized weapons and robotic Child summons. Shizuru Fujino harbors a dangerously consuming devotion for her aloof junior, Natsuki Kuga.
famousQuote: Even if the world turns to ash, I will love you, Natsuki.

title: Happy Sugar Life
nativeTitle: ハッピーシュガーライフ
synopsis: High schooler Matsuzaka Satou was known for being promiscuous until she met the pure young orphan Shio Koube. Believing she has finally discovered true love, Satou will commit kidnapping and even murder to protect their sweet life together.
famousQuote: My sweet, sweet sugar life... no one can take Shio from me.

title: Netsuzou Trap -NTR-
synopsis: Yuma gets her first boyfriend and asks her experienced childhood friend Hotaru for double-date advice. Hotaru begins giving her scandalous "practice" kisses in secret, leading Yuma into an obsessive web of forbidden temptation.
famousQuote: Don't pretend you don't like doing this with me more than him.

title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!
synopsis: Following the painful collapse of the band CRYCHIC, socially anxious vocalist Tomori Takamatsu and transfer student Anon Chihaya form a new rock band. Intense teenage resentment, longing, and heavy emotional entanglements clash.
famousQuote: Why did you play Haruhikage?!
pairing: Tomori Takamatsu x Anon Chihaya / Soyo x Sakiko

title: BanG Dream!
synopsis: Kasumi Toyama searches for the sparkling, heart-pounding sensation of the "Star Beat". Gathering friends to form the girls band Poppin'Party, she forms profound ties with tsundere keyboardist Arisa Ichigaya.
famousQuote: Let's find the star beat together, Arisa!

title: Love Live! School Idol Project
nativeTitle: ラブライブ！ School idol project
synopsis: Honoka Kosaka forms the school idol group μ's (Muse) to save Otonokizaka High from closing down. Among the members blossom legendary ships, particularly student council president Eli Ayase and tarot-loving Nozomi Tojo.
famousQuote: Nozomi, power inject! We belong together in μ's.
pairing: Eli Ayase x Nozomi Tojo / Nico x Maki

title: Love Live! Sunshine!!
nativeTitle: ラブライブ！サンシャイン!!
synopsis: In seaside Uchiura, Chika Takami founds the school idol group Aqours. Intense bonds form between childhood friends Kanan and Dia, as well as the deep emotional connection between fallen angel Yoshiko and Hanamaru.
famousQuote: Step zero to one! We will shine together, no matter how small our town is.
pairing: Chika x Riko / Kanan x Dia / Yoshiko x Hanamaru

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club
romaji: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai
nativeTitle: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会
synopsis: Childhood friends Yuu Takasaki and Ayumu Uehara enter Nijigasaki High and resurrect the school idol club. When Yuu becomes inspired by all the diverse idol girls, Ayumu's intense, possessive feelings surface in unforgettable melodrama.
famousQuote: Yuu-chan... why aren't you looking only at me anymore?

title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow
nativeTitle: 熱帯魚は雪に焦がれる
synopsis: Konatsu Amano moves to a rural seaside town in Ehime. Feeling lonely and anxious, she visits the high school aquarium club and meets the stoic, beautiful Koyuki Honami, who hides her own deep sense of isolation.
famousQuote: Even an aquarium in the winter snow can be warm when we are together.
aliases: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

title: Kashimashi: Girl Meets Girl
nativeTitle: かしまし ～ガール・ミーツ・ガール～
synopsis: Timid boy Hazumu is rejected by Yasuna and flees to Mount Kashimayama, where an alien spaceship crash-lands and kills him. Resurrected by the aliens with an anatomically female body, Hazumu returns to high school as a girl.
famousQuote: Even though my body changed, my feelings for you never disappeared.
pairing: Hazumu Osaragi x Yasuna Kamiizumi / Tomari

title: Our Teachers Are Dating!
nativeTitle: 早間先生と寺野先生は付き合っている
synopsis: Hayama-sensei and Terano-sensei are two sweet female teachers working at the same high school. Secretly dating, they spend their lunch breaks and evenings blushing, sharing cuddles, and supporting each other through school days.
famousQuote: Being teachers by day and girlfriends by night is the greatest joy.

title: Tadokoro-san
synopsis: Tadokoro is an outcast otaku who secretly draws web manga. One day, Nikaido—the most glamorous, popular girl in school—discovers Tadokoro's secret manga account and reveals herself to be her absolute number one super-fan.
famousQuote: Your manga is brilliant, Tadokoro-san... and you are even cuter!

title: School Zone Girls
synopsis: A chaotic, hilarious comedy chronicling the daily misadventures of delinquent high school girls Yokoyan and Sugiura, whose nonstop bickering and slacker antics mask mutual infatuation.
famousQuote: We're complete hopeless idiots, but at least we're hopeless idiots together.

title: Vampeerz
synopsis: At her grandmother's funeral, 14-year-old Ichika meets a mysterious silver-haired foreign girl named Aria. Aria is an ancient vampire seeking an heirloom blade that can finally grant her eternal rest—by Ichika's hand.
famousQuote: The moment our lips touched, I knew you held my life and my death.

title: Cheerful Amnesia
synopsis: Mari wakes up in the hospital having lost the last three years of memories—including the fact that she has been happily dating her girlfriend Arisa. Arisa takes her home, and Mari immediately falls in love with her all over again.
famousQuote: I forgot our entire history, but you are still the cutest girl I've ever seen!

title: After Hours
synopsis: Aimless 24-year-old Emi gets separated from friends at a club and meets Kei, a charismatic and spontaneous female DJ. Kei sweeps Emi into Tokyo's vibrant electronic music nightlife, igniting creative sparks and romance.
famousQuote: The bass drops, the lights flash, and in this crowded club, I only hear your heart.

title: Even Though We're Adults
synopsis: Takako Shimura's poignant adult drama: Ayano is an elementary school teacher married to a man, but an unexpected kiss at a dining bar with energetic bartender Akari awakens deep suppressed feelings.
famousQuote: Growing up doesn't mean you ever figure out who your heart belongs to.

title: Hero-san and Former General-san
nativeTitle: ヒーローさんと元女幹部さん
synopsis: Tokusatsu superheroine Honey Lemon defeats the evil organization Antinoid. Following the collapse of the villain syndicate, former villain general Honey General ends up moving into the superheroine's apartment!
famousQuote: Yesterday we traded lethal kicks—today you're cooking breakfast in an apron.

title: Breasts Are My Favorite Things in the World!
romaji: Sekai de Ichiban Oppai ga Suki!
nativeTitle: 世界で一番おっぱいが好き！
synopsis: High school girl Chiaki harbors an unabashed obsession with breasts. Her beautiful childhood classmate Hana has an impressive bust, and after a confession of desires, Hana agrees to let Chiaki touch her chest daily.
famousQuote: I don't just love her breasts—I love the girl they're attached to!
aliases: Breasts Are My Favorite Things in the World
Sekai de Ichiban Oppai ga Suki

title: Hino-san no Baka
synopsis: Class committee member Koguma constantly tries to stop delinquent slacker Hino from skipping classes behind the school building. In response, Hino plays increasingly intimate and teasing pranks on the flustered straight-A student.
famousQuote: Hino-san, you idiot! Stop teasing me like that!

title: The Sheep Princess in Wolf's Clothing
synopsis: In a fairy-tale kingdom of demi-humans, Momo the gentle sheep princess selects Aki, a fierce and fearsome female wolf warrior, to be her personal bodyguard. Despite predatory wolf instincts, Aki becomes head-over-heels devoted.
famousQuote: The wolf was meant to eat the sheep, but instead she gave her heart away.

title: Run Away With Me, Girl
synopsis: Ten years after high school, Maki runs into her first love Midori at a clinic. Midori is pregnant and trapped in a loveless engagement with an unfaithful fiancé. Maki impulsively takes Midori's hand and proposes they elope together.
famousQuote: Pack your bags and run away with me. I won't let anyone break your heart again.

title: Akebi's Sailor Uniform
nativeTitle: 明日ちゃんのセーラー服
synopsis: Komichi Akebi wins admission to prestigious Roubai Academy, where she wears a traditional sailor uniform sewn by her mother. With her radiant curiosity, she captivates her classmates, especially the poised pianist Erika Kizaki.
famousQuote: Erika, will you accompany my dance with your piano?

title: Candy Boy
synopsis: Twin sisters Kanade and Yukino Sakurai share a room at an all-girls student dormitory in Tokyo. Their exceptionally sweet, affectionate daily intimacy is gently complicated by an enthusiastic junior classmate, Sakuya.
famousQuote: No matter what happens, Yukino and I will always share one umbrella.

title: Kuttsukiboshi
synopsis: Kiiko Kawakami has psychic telekinetic powers. During empty summer vacation classrooms, she meets mysterious transfer student Aaya Saito, embarking on an emotionally charged and mystical romantic bond.
famousQuote: With these psychic hands, the only thing I want to hold is you.

title: A Kiss for the Petals
nativeTitle: その花びらにくちづけを
synopsis: At the prestigious St. Michael's Girls Academy, elegant student council president Nanami and cheerful kouhai Yuuna navigate their secret romantic relationship behind campus doors.
famousQuote: A single petal falls, sealed with our sweetest kiss.

title: Qualia the Purple
synopsis: Mariii Marii sees all humans as mechanical robots, but possesses mysterious superhuman abilities. When Mariii is murdered by a shadowy scientific cabal, her friend Manabu Gaku shifts across countless parallel quantum universes for centuries to save her.
famousQuote: Even if I have to dismantle the universe itself, I will bring you back.

title: VTuber Legend
romaji: VTuber Nanda ga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
nativeTitle: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
synopsis: Awayuki Kokorone is a refined VTuber until she forgets to end her stream and ends up drunkenly chugging beer and rambling yuri fantasies live to hundreds of thousands. Soon, real sparks fly with idol VTuber Mashiro.
famousQuote: I forgot to turn off the stream, but my love for cute girls was 100% real!

title: Train to the End of the World
nativeTitle: 終末トレインどこへいく？
synopsis: Following an experimental 7G cellular launch that mutates the world, high schooler Shizuru Chikura commandeers an abandoned Seibu train with friends to travel down apocalyptic railroad tracks to find her lost best friend Yoka.
famousQuote: We will ride this train to the very edge of the earth just to see you again.
aliases: Train to the End of the World

title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san
synopsis: Yachiyo Inugami is a dog-like girl who adores cats, while Suzu Nekoyama is a cat-like girl who loves dogs. When their mutual friend Aki introduces them, immediate sparks and comedy ignite between canine and feline personalities.
famousQuote: She's like a cat, and I'm like a puppy—we're destined to tumble together!

title: Octave
synopsis: Yukino is a 18-year-old former teen idol whose pop group disbanded in failure. Disowned by her family, she attends a manager's wedding and meets Setsuko, a cynical audio engineer. A mature, raw romance unfolds in Tokyo.
famousQuote: We are both broken chords that found a way to harmonize.

title: Prism
synopsis: Megumi enters high school hoping for romance and encounters Hikaru, a tall, handsome girl who inadvertently steals her heart. A beautifully drawn, tender high school romance filled with gentle discoveries.
famousQuote: Like white light through a prism, being with you shows me every color.

title: Gunjou (Ride or Die)
synopsis: Ching Nakamura's gripping noir thriller: A lesbian doctor murders the abusive husband of her former classmate Nanae at her desperate request. Bound by blood and guilt, the two women flee on an apocalyptic road trip across Japan.
famousQuote: I murdered for you. Now there is nowhere left to run except into each other.

title: Blue Drop: Tenshi-tachi no Gikyoku
synopsis: Mari lost all childhood memories when her entire island was wiped out in a mysterious catastrophe. Sent to an elite academy, she meets Hagino, an alien commander torn between duty to her invading race and her love for Mari.
famousQuote: My spaceship came to conquer your world, but your eyes conquered my soul.

title: Rin: Daughters of Mnemosyne
nativeTitle: Mnemosyne -ムネモシュネの娘たち-
synopsis: Rin Asogi is an immortal private investigator in Shinjuku who has tasted death countless times. Alongside her hacker assistant Mimi, Rin investigates sinister biotechnical horrors across six decades of modern and futuristic Tokyo.
famousQuote: Spanning sixty years and a hundred deaths, Mimi and I endure.

title: Noir
synopsis: Bee Train's classic girls-with-guns thriller: Corsican assassin Mireille Bouquet teams up with amnesiac Japanese assassin prodigy Kirika Yuumura under the ancient codename "Noir" to uncover their intertwined bloodstained past.
famousQuote: Noir... an ancient name for fate, spoken only by two maidens holding guns.

title: El Cazador de la Bruja
synopsis: Bounty hunter Nadie tracks down Ellis, a genetically engineered "witch" wanted for murder. Instead of turning her in for the reward, Nadie becomes Ellis's protector on a dusty road trip south toward the legendary holy land of Wiñay Marka.
famousQuote: I was hired to hunt you, but I'd rather spend my bullets protecting you.

title: Madlax
synopsis: In war-torn Gazth-Sonika, elite mercenary Madlax can dodge bullets with uncanny grace. Meanwhile in peaceful Nafrece, wealthy aristocrat Margaret Burton seeks memories of a tragedy twelve years ago. Their souls are tied by a holy book.
famousQuote: Across two halves of the world, our lives are woven by the same melody.

title: Kakegurui
synopsis: At Hyakkaou Private Academy, social hierarchy is determined solely by high-stakes gambling. Compulsive gambler Yumeko Jabami turns the academy upside down, igniting intense rivalry and magnetic tension with Mary Saotome.
famousQuote: Let us gamble until our minds shatter completely!
pairing: Mary Saotome x Yumeko Jabami / Ririka Momobami

title: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angel and Dragon
romaji: Cross Ange: Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo
nativeTitle: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞
synopsis: Princess Angelise is stripped of royalty and exiled to the frontline base Arzenal when she is revealed to be a "Norma" who cannot use Mana. Battling invading DRAGONs in mecha, she wins the fiery devotion of rebel pilot Hilda.
famousQuote: I will survive, spit on this rotten world, and take everything I want!

title: Valkyrie Drive: Mermaid
nativeTitle: ヴァルキリードライヴ マーメイド
synopsis: On artificial prison islands, girls infected with the A-Virus can transform into lethal weapons (Extars) through sexual arousal provided by Liberators. Timid Mamori transforms into a sacred sword wielded by fierce fighter Mirei.
famousQuote: Kiss me, Mamori... let me draw your blade!

title: Assault Lily: Bouquet
synopsis: Teenage warrior maidens known as "Lilies" wield transforming CHARM weapons to battle monstrous Huge. Optimistic rookie Riri enrolls at elite Yurigaoka Academy to become the Schutzengel partner of stoic ace Yuyu Shirai.
famousQuote: I became a Lily because I wanted to fight by your side, Yuyu-sama!

title: Granbelm
synopsis: Under every full moon, high schoolers pilot giant magical mecha Armanox to battle for the mantle of the world's single Magiaconatus sorceress. Ordinary girl Mangetsu meets stoic doll-like rival Shingetsu Ernesta Fukami.
famousQuote: Even if magic disappears from this world, our memories never will.
pairing: Mangetsu Kohinata x Shingetsu Ernesta Fukami

title: Slow Loop
synopsis: Hiyori loves fly-fishing, a pastime taught by her deceased father. When her mother remarries, she discovers her new stepsister is cheerful Koharu, and the two girls bond deeply over fly-fishing and homemade meals.
famousQuote: Casting our lines side-by-side makes the whole world feel peaceful.

title: Asteroid in Love
synopsis: As a child, Mira met a boy named Ao at a campsite and promised to discover an asteroid together. Entering high school astronomy club, she discovers "Ao" is actually a girl, and their childhood promise burns brighter than ever.
famousQuote: We promised under the summer night sky: we will name an asteroid together!

title: Kin-iro Mosaic
synopsis: Shinobu Omiya homestayed in England with Alice Cartelet. Years later, blonde Alice moves to Japan to live with Shinobu, alongside boisterous half-British Karen Kujo and mutual childhood friends Aya and Yoko.
famousQuote: Shino! I crossed the sea from England just to be with you!
pairing: Shinobu x Alice / Aya x Yoko

title: Is the Order a Rabbit?
nativeTitle: ご注文はうさぎですか？
synopsis: Cocoa moves to a European-style storybook town to board at the Rabbit House cafe. She treats younger barista Chino like a beloved little sister, while cafe coworker Rize and green tea maiden Sharo share adorable romantic chemistry.
famousQuote: My heart is all hop-stepping! Leave everything to your big sister Cocoa!
pairing: Cocoa x Chino / Rize x Sharo

title: Non Non Biyori
synopsis: Hotaru Ichijou transfers from Tokyo to a tiny countryside school with only five students. Despite being an elementary fifth-grader, she towers over petite middle-schooler Komari Koshigaya, harboring a secret room packed with handmade Komari plushies.
famousQuote: Koma-chan is the most adorable person in the entire world!

title: Comic Girls
synopsis: Struggling 4-koma manga artist Kaoruko Moeta (Chaos) moves into an all-girls manga creator dormitory. Living with shoujo artist Koyume, boy's love artist Ruki, and shonen artist Tsubasa, they encourage each other through deadlines.
famousQuote: Ababababa! My manuscripts are in trouble, but my roommates give me courage!
pairing: Kaoruko x Koyume / Ruki x Tsubasa

title: New Game!
synopsis: Aoba Suzukaze joins video game studio Eagle Jump right after high school. Working on Fairies Story 3 under character designer Kou Yagami, she witnesses the longtime domestic intimacy between senior designers Kou and Rin Toyama.
famousQuote: Rin has always been the one looking out for me, in the office and at home.

title: Fluttering Feelings
synopsis: Ssamba's beloved Korean manhwa classic: Business major Kim No-rae is sensible and reserved. When she meets popular, stunning classmate Baek Seol-a, an unforgettable slow-burn romance blossoms between campus lectures and rainy evenings.
famousQuote: Whenever I see your face, my heart flutters with feelings I never understood.

title: Lily Love
synopsis: Ratana Satis's smash-hit Thai GL webtoon: Innocent university student Donut moves into a new apartment complex and encounters Mew, an alluring senior architecture student next door who opens her heart to love.
famousQuote: Love blooms softly, like a pure white lily in summer.

title: Moonlight Garden
synopsis: Set in a historical pleasure brothel of flower maidens with aphrodisiac scents, Dohwa seeks a rare potion to escape her courtesan fate. She becomes ensnared in a passionate triangle with young mistress Lady Hyewon and guard Yushin.
famousQuote: In this flower garden of moonlight and desire, you are my only freedom.

title: Ring My Bell!
synopsis: Webtoon artist Sohn Yeon-woo gets assigned to write a romance webtoon right after being dumped. Her uptight new neighbor Mai complains about thin apartment walls, but soon agrees to help Yeon-woo study romance.
famousQuote: Our doorbells kept ringing, until you finally walked into my life.

title: Sora & Haena
synopsis: Haena is a stylish gyaru girl who wants to look cool but has zero dating experience. Timid model student Sora agrees to give her private dating tutoring in exchange for help making friends.
famousQuote: Tutoring you about dating was supposed to be easy... until I fell for you.

title: Opium
synopsis: In Japanese-occupied 1940s Gyeongseong, female physician Mary treats high-society patients. When she is called to examine the mysterious, aristocratic Lady Marianne, an intoxicating and dangerous conspiracy unfolds.
famousQuote: Your touch is an addictive poison I have no desire to cure.

title: Nevermore
synopsis: Kit & Trace's hit gothic supernatural Webtoon inspired by Edgar Allan Poe: In the afterlife Academy of Nevermore, deceased souls Annabel Lee and Lenore must compete in gruesome trials to reclaim their forgotten earthly memories.
famousQuote: We loved with a love that was more than love.

title: Always Human
synopsis: In a near future where nanotech body modifications allow everyone to change hair, eye color, and biology instantly, Sunati notices Austen, a girl without mods due to an autoimmune disorder. A tender, luminous romance begins.
famousQuote: No matter what mods you wear, you are always beautifully human to me.

title: Soulmate
nativeTitle: 双生灵探 / 灵魂伴侣
synopsis: Ke Ran Bing's celebrated emotional time-travel romance: 27-year-old Qi Yan awakens ten years in the past as a high school senior. Determined to prevent her dying lover Yuan Zi's tragic illness, she cherishes every single second.
famousQuote: If time gives me a second chance, I will hold you tight and never let you slip away.

title: Baili Jin Among Mortals
synopsis: Baili Jin, a fairy from the heavenly realm, descends to the mortal world to experience modern life. She moves in with ordinary mortal woman Tong Sisi, learning about city life, bubble tea, and romantic feelings.
famousQuote: The mortal world has many wonders, but none shine brighter than you.

title: Straight Girl Trap
synopsis: Chen Ling is convinced her capable, charismatic female corporate manager Xiao Nan is an unattainable "straight girl." But as Xiao Nan gives her flirtatious signals and private favors, the line between straight and smitten dissolves.
famousQuote: Are you really straight, or is this the sweetest trap I've ever stepped into?

title: Lily
synopsis: Yy's legendary marathon manhua following energetic athlete Fan Yilun and quiet model student Ruoxi from their first high school meeting through years of emotional growth, friendship, and unspoken love.
famousQuote: Year after year, my gaze always returns to where you are standing.

title: Relationship Guidelines
synopsis: Jiwon and Jisoo have been inseparable best friends since childhood. When Jisoo proposes they establish "guidelines" for their relationship, both girls struggle to suppress feelings that clearly cross into romance.
famousQuote: Best friends don't kiss like this... so what are we now?

title: White Angels Have No Wings
synopsis: At an austere Christian girls high school, meek victim Ayeon is tormented by bullies until ruthless transfer student Minseo arrives. A toxic, hypnotic psychological relationship forms between savior and victim.
famousQuote: In this cruel purgatory, even the angels carry wicked thorns.

title: The Third Party
synopsis: Song Jeong-eun enters an arranged political marriage arranged by her chaebol family. At the broadcast station, she encounters fierce, passionate TV producer PD Kang, leading to an explosive affair.
famousQuote: My marriage was an illusion—you are the only truth I want.

title: Serenade
synopsis: At a prestigious university music conservatory, Hayeon is captivated by brilliant cello prodigy Jin-ah. Amidst the demanding pressure of classical recitals, their music mirrors intense, unspoken romantic longing.
famousQuote: Every bow drawn across the strings plays a serenade only meant for you.

title: Ghosts of Greywoods
synopsis: In 19th-century Victorian England, impoverished maid Tamara arrives at the ominous Greywoods Manor to care for Collin, a sickly young lady confined to her bed. Dark family curses and hidden passions intertwine.
famousQuote: The ghosts of this estate cannot extinguish the warmth of your hand.

title: Sadistic Beauty: Side Story B
synopsis: The acclaimed yuri side-story spinoff of Sadistic Beauty: Cold, guarded Gyerin and innocent, warm Minju navigate intense psychological boundaries, vulnerability, and erotic devotion.
famousQuote: I never let anyone inside my walls... why did you have to break through?

title: Show Me Your Bust
synopsis: A hilarious high school romantic comedy following Suyeon, who gets caught in embarrassing misunderstandings with glamorous beauty Jiyoung, leading to outrageous situations and undeniable mutual affection.
famousQuote: One misunderstanding after another, and now I can't imagine life without you!

title: Green Tea Bitch
synopsis: Su Tang transmigrates into a romance novel as the scheming "green tea bitch" antagonist tasked with seducing the male lead. Instead, she falls head-over-heels for the elegant, untouchable female lead Tang Wan.
famousQuote: Who cares about the male lead? The heroine is ten thousand times prettier!

title: I Want to Love You Until You Die
romaji: Kimi ga Shinu Made Koi wo Shitai
nativeTitle: 君が死ぬまで恋をしたい
synopsis: In a magic military orphanage training orphaned children into disposable weapons for war, immortal test subject Shiina arrives covered in scars. She meets gentle healer Mimi, who vows to love her until death parts them.
famousQuote: In this school of death, loving you is the only reason my heart beats.
aliases: Kimi ga Shinu Made Koi wo Shitai

title: Murcielago
synopsis: Mass-murderer Kuroko Koumori is offered a deal by the Japanese police: avoid execution by becoming a state executioner hunting monstrous criminal syndicates. In her downtime, Kuroko seduces every gorgeous woman in sight.
famousQuote: I slaughter monsters by day and charm beauties all night long.

title: Hana & Hina After School
synopsis: Milk Morinaga's delightful high school romance: Petite, hardworking Hana works part-time at a cute character goods store. When tall, fashionable gyaru Hina is hired at the same shop, a sweet after-school secret romance begins.
famousQuote: Our part-time shift ends, but our feelings are just clocking in.

title: Kanamemo
synopsis: Orphaned middle schooler Kana Nakamachi finds a job and lodging at the Fuhshin Gazette newspaper delivery office. Living alongside open lesbian couple Yuhki and Hinata, Kana experiences warm, lively daily companionship.
famousQuote: Delivering morning papers is hard work, but this home is filled with warmth.

title: Shoujo Sect
synopsis: Ken Kurogane's classic high school drama: Shinobu and Momoko were intimate friends in childhood. Reunited in high school, Shinobu is now a rebel gyaru while Momoko is a prim student council member, reigniting intense passion.
famousQuote: No matter how much our lives change, you were always my first love.

title: HEN (Strange)
synopsis: Gantz creator Hiroya Oku's early landmark work: Gorgeous school beauty Chizuru Yoshida is completely infatuated with quirky, tomboyish transfer student Azumi Yamada, pursuing her with shameless romantic determination.
famousQuote: Everyone worships me, but the only girl I want to look at is you!
